evidence_summary: Cryo-EM resolved a near-intact 2:2:2 Sema3A/PlexinA4/neuropilin-1 extracellular complex with multiple subunit interfaces, including a previously unrecognized Nrp1-Sema3A interaction.
limitations: The structure defines a receptor complex and multiple contacts, not an isolated PlexinA4 ligand affinity; terminal TF was not measured. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction or preserved receptor-complex claim; no SCI-context or downstream relay inference is made.

evidence_summary: PAI-1/SERPINE1 bound LRP1 in free and protease-complexed forms; tPA-PAI-1 complexes bound LRP and were internalized, and mutational solution-fluorescence assays mapped a high-affinity PAI-1/LRP1 interface involving four basic PAI-1 residues and LRP1 CR domains.
limitations: LRP1 is a large heterodimeric clearance/signaling receptor and PAI-1 affinity is altered by uPA/tPA complexing and surface localization. No terminal TF or SCI model. evidence_summary: Human natural and recombinant SP-D bound soluble extracellular TLR2 and TLR4 domains through the carbohydrate-recognition domain; a later rat chondrocyte study reported SP-D binding to the TLR4/MD-2 complex.
limitations: The biochemical record uses soluble ectodomains and the functional study uses rat cartilage; collectin oligomerization, MD-2, Ca2+, and LPS context determine binding and direction of signaling.
